manifest.name: @keqingmoe/oh-my-dsh
manifest.description: A curated Web bundle for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3

bundle.text:
# DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 Web composition.
# Dependencies are installed from the npm registry; their own dsh.bundle
# patches are not applied automatically. Keep these public row ids stable:
# user patches may target them.
- insert:
    - id: llm-openai-codex
      name: dsh-codex
    - id: dsh-mobile-upgrade
      name: dsh-mobile-upgrade

# dsh-web-startup-auth replaces the stock startup and delays the connection
# until authentication wraps the server. Keep these overrides with its rows.
- id: web-startup
  disabled: true
- id: connection
  inject: [webServer, webStartup, webAuth]
  config:
    trustedHosts: !!js ctx.webStartup.trustedHosts
- insert:
    - id: dsh-web-startup-auth
      name: dsh-web-startup-auth
    - id: remote-web-startup
      name: dsh-web-startup-auth/startup
    - id: web-auth
      name: dsh-web-startup-auth/auth

- insert:
    - id: mobile-enter-newline
      name: '@jiesou/dsh-webui-fix-mobile-enter-newline'
    - id: better-sidebar
      name: dsh-better-sidebar
      disabled: !!js "[...ctx.loader.entries()].some((e) => e.options.name === 'dsh-better-sidebar' && e.options.id !== 'better-sidebar' && !e.disabled)"

# Search-provider switcher. The row only puts the package in the boot graph; its
# client half is discovered from the package's own dsh.client metadata.
- insert:
    - id: search-switch
      name: dsh-search-switch

# MCP manager: one row carries both halves — the host McpManagerService and the
# Settings → MCP page, the latter through the package's dsh.client metadata.
# Do not insert a second row with this id; override this one instead.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-mcp
      name: dsh-mcp

readme.text: DSH Web 插件组合：手机界面、登录、搜索 provider 切换、MCP 管理、代码侧栏、Codex 支持。

readme.section: 或直接从 GitHub 安装
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:KeqingMoe/oh-my-dsh
```

安装后重启 DSH Web。本包面向 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3`；如果已有旧版
`oh-my-dsh` 或同名插件，先移除再安装。

| 功能 | 插件 |
|---|---|
| 手机界面 | `dsh-mobile-upgrade` |
| Web 登录 | `dsh-web-startup-auth` |
| 手机 Enter 换行 | `@jiesou/dsh-webui-fix-mobile-enter-newline` |
| 文件、Git 与终端侧栏 | `dsh-better-sidebar` |
| Codex Web | `dsh-codex` |
| 搜索 provider 切换 | `dsh-search-switch` |
| MCP 管理界面 | `dsh-mcp` |

readme.section: 已知限制：安装或卸载后必须重启
readme.text:
DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 的插件热重载只覆盖「可替换」的插件；已加载的插件模块留在 ESM 缓存里，fiber
仍持有注册，进程内没有受支持的卸载/重新导入方式。本包用 `dsh-web-startup-auth` 替换了内置的
`web-startup` 行，所以安装或卸载都会动到启动层——`dsh plugin --profile web add/remove` 之后
**必须重启 `dsh web`**，否则启动层的生命周期会留在不一致状态，只能靠重启恢复。

这是上游限制，不是本包 patch 的问题：

readme.section: 已知限制：安装或卸载后必须重启
readme.text:
- 官方变更日志（v0.2.1-rc.1）：「启用热重载时，更新或重新安装的可替换插件直接生效，无法热重载时提示重启。」<https://www.dsh.so/zh/changelog/>
- Discussion #1231 *Host capability: graceful self-restart for plugin managers*：已加载的插件代码无法安全重新导入，更新流程最终都停在「请手动重启」。<https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1231>
- Discussion #2717（中文）：建议官方提供「重启扩展服务」与完整插件更新生命周期。<https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2717>
`dsh-mobile-upgrade` 的许可见 [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)；本项目采用 [MIT 许可](LICENSE)。
